program: SYM-02 — Threshold K Refinement + Independent Concept Exploration
question: Can a controlled descendant improve the exact selected Threshold K without erasing its identity, and can any genuinely independent monochrome concept challenge it, before color, material, motion, wordmark, state, hero or implementation coupling?

control.name: Threshold K
control.law: C0-ORIGINAL is only a review alias for exact canonical C0. Its bytes and geometry are immutable in SYM-02.

calibration.historical_challenger: F1 Split Field may appear only as a non-editable historical benchmark; it is not reopened or eligible for SYM-02 promotion.
calibration.generic_control: CNEG may appear only as a non-eligible genericity calibration if useful.

C0-R1.name: Bézier Fidelity
C0-R1.allowed_change: Replace raster-trace stair stepping with intentional smooth vector interpolation while preserving component count, outer extrema, negative-space K topology, dominant/right-versus-left mass hierarchy and all identity-defining junctions.
C0-R1.forbidden_change: No spacing opening, no new counterform, no silhouette redesign, no component merge/split, no intentional K strengthening.
C0-R1.mechanical_tolerance: C0 outer extrema exact; component count exact; total filled area within 2 percent of C0; filled centroid within 1.5 viewBox units; every identity-defining K-facing vertex/turn remains within 1.5 viewBox units of its C0 source location.

C0-R2.name: Curve/Tension Study
C0-R2.allowed_change: Change only the right field's inner waist/return tension; left fields and right-field outer envelope remain exact C0 geometry.
C0-R2.forbidden_change: No left-field edit, no envelope expansion/contraction, no new negative-space branch, no letterform regularization.
C0-R2.mechanical_tolerance: All left-field path data byte-identical to C0; right-field outer-edge coordinates byte-identical where separable; edited inner-waist control/anchor displacement no more than 6 viewBox units; right-field bounding box exact.

C0-R3.name: Proportion Study
C0-R3.allowed_change: Change only the exterior mass proportion of the two left fields while preserving their K-facing inner boundaries, the inter-left gap and the complete right field.
C0-R3.forbidden_change: No K-facing contour edit, no right-field edit, no component-count change, no spacing experiment.
C0-R3.mechanical_tolerance: Complete right-field path byte-identical to C0; K-facing left-field boundary coordinates unchanged; left-field filled area may change by at most 8 percent in aggregate; overall left-field centroid shift no more than 4 viewBox units.

C0-R4.name: Production Vector Candidate
C0-R4.construction_rule: Do not construct in the initial batch. It may exist only after review if exactly one refinement direction survives and a clean audit finds consolidation justified. R4 naming never confers production authority.

N1.name: Counterform Junction
N1.topology: One compact asymmetric field with two edge-open negative cuts entering from different sides and approaching an off-center junction without forming a closed aperture.
N1.theme: hidden structure becoming visible through convergence
N1.forbidden_drift: K/letterform, trident, crop/focus mark, arrow, eye, doorway, aperture, three-field Threshold-K descendant

N2.name: Tension Quartet
N2.topology: Four unequal non-mirrored masses arranged around one bent open negative corridor; no enclosing frame, radial symmetry, central dot or closed counterform.
N2.theme: many distinct perspectives held in one coherent tension
N2.forbidden_drift: sparkle, plus/cross, loading spinner, four-way control, people/entities, tile/grid or three-field Threshold-K descendant

N3.name: Emergent Spine
N3.topology: Three unequal compact masses distributed along one bent implied spine with deliberately different orientations and no enclosing frame; the identity event is the alignment between masses rather than a letter-shaped void.
N3.theme: ensemble coherence emerging from distinct contributions
N3.forbidden_drift: ellipsis, people/team, equalizer, layers, chevron/process arrow, network nodes or Threshold-K descendant

neutralization: single currentColor only; no gradients, texture, blur, glow, shadow, depth, material or palette identity
no wordmark, letters, monograms, typography or semantic product glyphs in scored symbols
no motion/state treatment and no hero/imagery context
all candidates use self-contained SVG and identical review framing

review_matrix.rule: Candidate geometry is invariant across size, context and mode.

mechanical_floors: C0 canonical LF SHA-256 must match the frozen SYM-01 value
all scored SVGs must be self-contained, deterministic-viewBox, currentColor-only and contain no text/external resources
no clipping at any review size or context
refinement candidates must satisfy their exact allowed-change boundary when diffed against C0
independent concepts must not reuse C0's three-field K-counterform topology or any failed SYM-01 family by superficial redraw
subjective_falsification: FAIL if a refinement loses the discovered-in-the-void K event, weakens compact tension without a compensating gain, or becomes more deliberately letter-like than C0.
FAIL if a refinement's purported improvement is not visible or useful at 16-32 px and is merely vector tidiness at display scale.
FAIL if an independent concept reads primarily as a familiar software/category/control glyph or literal semantic icon.
FAIL if an independent concept depends on decorative detail lost below 24 px.
FAIL if any candidate needs color, material, motion or wordmark to feel authored.
FAIL if an N-series candidate is materially a redraw of C0 or retired F2/F3/F4 rather than an independent concept.
PASS means only survival to direct comparison; it does not establish final symbol or production authority.
review_order: 1. source/topology and allowed-change audit before browser exposure
2. 16/20/24/32 px silhouette, negative-space and unintended-symbol audit
5. direct comparison of survivors against exact C0-ORIGINAL
6. freeze Design Sol ranking before any Director taste input

termination.director_gate: Only if multiple materially valid survivors remain and the distinction is aesthetic/product-semantic rather than falsifiable, present the human-viewable frozen board with Design Sol's pre-frozen ranking.

explicit_non_authority: No final logo/app icon, production vector, Store/package asset or trademark clearance.
No app/site implementation or Phase-C convergence.
audit_result: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
